page.headline: Do rsync and xs tools hold their ranking through the weekend?
page.intro: The lab is checking whether file-transfer tools keep their relative ranking over time. One runner, Mac to apollo (Linux), is running a sentinel experiment with 12 samples now. No follow-on branches are queued for the day.

runners.title: Mac ↔ apollo: mars's box on Linux

items.asks: rsync, xs-c++ and xs-rs keep their congress ranking through the weekend.
